parent.title: Development publisher: git delivery truth and bounded recovery
parent.description: Approved implementation planned by noble-crest. Jack approved in chat on 2026-09-27; no further human review gate. Follow projects/agent-queue/plans/2026-09-27-development-publisher-delivery-truth.md. Remove duplicate DB delivery truth, ship ancestry-first and bounded stall slices early, preserve existing bright-flare and azure-lantern fixes. This is the implementation epic, separate from the completed planning task.

nodes.title: Use shared git delivery truth before publisher dependency evaluation
nodes.description:
Approved implementation from noble-crest; Jack approved spec and implementation in chat on 2026-09-27. Read projects/agent-queue/plans/2026-09-27-development-publisher-delivery-truth.md before editing; its Shared contract and resolved choices control over the older cache wording in the spec. No new human review gate. Keep development mode. Every mutation uses CommandHandler and production git I/O uses async GitManager. Preserve bright-flare 23c6fe844 and azure-lantern 86338d77b already in main; do not duplicate or manipulate their live incident tasks. Publish your assigned branch before closing. Run focused and area checks with aq test and baseline failure comparison; no whole suite. Add selection ownership and regenerate the catalogue for any new test module or unowned source path. 

Scope: Add src/integration/delivery_truth.py with async repository/target/current-completion-scoped evidence, then call it before development.py candidate sorting, cycles and ancestor checks. Results distinguish contained, no artifact, pending and unknown. Pin fetched target OID; unknown/fetch failure is not delivered. Branchless organizational containers have no own artifact, while a missing ref or branchless code completion with a recorded source is not automatically empty. Inspect all completed candidates independently so misleading receipt rows cannot exclude undelivered work. Legacy source heads may locate commits temporarily but every result requires git proof; centralize this bridge and label it for operations/retire removal. Preserve adopted-repair pruning and clear diagnostics when actual containment makes work leave evaluation. Define reusable batch snapshot and freshness interface for admission/consumers without writing git facts into DB. Own candidate preflight only; isolate owns merge assembly and recovery, stalls owns diagnostics.

Verification commands:
- aq test tests/test_development_integration.py
- aq test tests/test_development_integration.py tests/test_integration_controls.py tests/test_blocked_state.py
- ruff check <changed paths>
acceptance: Eleven-way missing-ancestor and contained-candidate regressions pass with missing refs and misleading receipt states.
Wrong repo/target, archived identities, new completion generation and git errors are covered; no persisted delivered flag added.
Publisher uses one evaluator and exports its request-scoped snapshot contract for later consumers. First slice can ship independently.

nodes.title: Bound repeated publisher skips and notify once at ERROR severity
nodes.description:
Approved implementation from noble-crest; Jack approved spec and implementation in chat on 2026-09-27. Read projects/agent-queue/plans/2026-09-27-development-publisher-delivery-truth.md before editing; its Shared contract and resolved choices control over the older cache wording in the spec. No new human review gate. Keep development mode. Every mutation uses CommandHandler and production git I/O uses async GitManager. Preserve bright-flare 23c6fe844 and azure-lantern 86338d77b already in main; do not duplicate or manipulate their live incident tasks. Publish your assigned branch before closing. Run focused and area checks with aq test and baseline failure comparison; no whole suite. Add selection ownership and regenerate the catalogue for any new test module or unowned source path. 

Scope: Extract publisher observational diagnostics from candidate assembly. Add positive configurable identical-evaluation threshold default five. Fingerprint candidate, completion generation, reason and relevant git evidence; count unsuccessful evaluations, not idle ticks or elapsed downtime. On crossing threshold, end that attempt as stalled, surface doctor ERROR and queue one supervisor inbox message containing task/repo/source/target/reason/recovery evidence. Persist only observations and deduplication, not delivery truth. A stalled attempt stops blind retries but still permits fresh containment checks; changed evidence or explicit recovery starts a new attempt. Restart retains count/dedupe, delivery clears stale diagnostics. Coordinate development.py diagnostic symbols with truth/isolate without serializing unrelated work. Own config/docs and doctor severity.

Verification commands:
- aq test tests/test_doctor_integration_checks.py
- aq test tests/test_development_integration.py tests/test_doctor_integration_checks.py tests/test_development_validation.py
- ruff check <changed paths>
acceptance: Fifth identical skip produces one ERROR diagnostic and one supervisor message; earlier ticks remain bounded progress observations.
Restart and further unchanged ticks do not spam; changed generation or target and proven delivery recover correctly.
No new delivery eligibility authority or delivery-receipt row is introduced.

nodes.title: Record exact task completion and repair provenance in git
nodes.description:
Approved implementation from noble-crest; Jack approved spec and implementation in chat on 2026-09-27. Read projects/agent-queue/plans/2026-09-27-development-publisher-delivery-truth.md before editing; its Shared contract and resolved choices control over the older cache wording in the spec. No new human review gate. Keep development mode. Every mutation uses CommandHandler and production git I/O uses async GitManager. Preserve bright-flare 23c6fe844 and azure-lantern 86338d77b already in main; do not duplicate or manipulate their live incident tasks. Publish your assigned branch before closing. Run focused and area checks with aq test and baseline failure comparison; no whole suite. Add selection ownership and regenerate the catalogue for any new test module or unowned source path. 

Scope: Implement a bounded provenance module and worker commit/close integration. AQ-Task identifies the task; completion evidence must identify the current immutable generation and exact final source, not any matching historical commit. Use existing claim/completion identity as workflow identity; keep the mapping in git. Preserve existing hooks and other workers worktrees, never rewrite pushed history, and retain provenance after source-branch cleanup/archive. Verify published complete evidence before successful close; ordinary commits carry task trailers. Define git-carried explicit replacement evidence naming every replaced task/generation/source for rebased repairs and operator equivalence. A partial cherry-pick or an empty marker alone must not prove delivery. Include a dry-run/apply migration command through CommandHandler that inventories legacy heads and exact repair bindings, writes only verified git provenance, reports ambiguous task ids and is idempotent. This task defines the representation and migration primitive; operations wires it into the publisher, retire removes the compatibility reader. Preserve valid code-free outcomes. Document which external rewrite evidence is required rather than promising automatic equivalence.

Verification commands:
- aq test tests/test_git_command_handlers.py tests/test_session_commands.py
- aq test tests/test_git_manager.py tests/test_git_manager_async.py tests/test_git_command_handlers.py tests/test_session_commands.py
- ruff check <changed paths>
acceptance: Real Git tests cover multiple commits, repeated close, reopened task, archived task, removed source branch, partial cherry-pick and complete repair replacement.
No DB git mapping or delivered boolean added; final source and generation are unambiguous and cannot be satisfied by an old AQ-Task trailer.
Legacy migration dry-run performs no writes; apply verifies git and preserves unmigratable evidence with explicit reasons.

deliverables.target: aq test tests/test_git_manager.py tests/test_git_manager_async.py tests/test_git_command_handlers.py tests/test_session_commands.py

Scope: Wire git completion/replacement provenance into delivery_truth and publisher/recovery lifecycle. Migrate old exact-source and adopted repair mappings with the provenance command; unknowns stay named and safe. Remove delivery-row reads and writes from candidate selection, adoption, parked resolution, reconcile_completion_sources and publication result truth. Retain only operation intent, validation executions, repair work contracts and bounded diagnostics needed for recovery, using existing event/job/operation infrastructure where possible. An operation record may describe an attempted push, never decide that a task is delivered. Inspect git after crash/uncertain push and before next action. Do not rename the delivery table into another receipt model. Keep validation results, infrastructure deferrals, repair generation budgets, expected-head push and cleanup safety. This task migrates runtime publisher writes; retire removes schema and remaining compatibility. Add an explicit inventory/zero check for fallback generations.

Restart at prepared/publishing/post-push boundaries reconciles actual git, without duplicate repairs or silent loss of validation evidence.
Migration reports unresolved identities; fully migrated fixtures have zero legacy fallback generations and no receipt writes.
